rationale: Per-key translator context for meta/machineFillGamelib.ts, added by quick task 260925-88h in response to the systemic defects quick task 260925-7zf measured (audit report .planning/quick/260925-7zf-automated-mt-quality-audit-of-gamelib-js/260925-7zf-REPORT.md): the fill collapsed distinct steps to one verb (Claim vs Redeem, Undo vs Cancel) and left the 'Giftable spares' UI section name in English inside activateConfirmBody in 21/48 locales, because the model had no context that these were meaningful distinctions rather than synonyms. A note keyed on a plural BASE path (e.g. a key with no _one/_other suffix) applies to every CLDR form of that group; a note keyed on a literal key path applies only to that key. redeemSteamKey.* is deliberately excluded -- it is a different feature (standalone Steam key redemption) where 'Redeem' is correct and there is no separate Claim step.
